name: 幻惑之卷物
desc: 宣言1个属性发动。装备怪兽的属性变成宣言的属性。
faq: If you switch the target of this card with "Collected Power" or "Tailor of the Fickle" you do not select a new Attribute. The newly equipped monster becomes the Attribute that was originally selected when "Scroll of Bewitchment" was activated, even if it is the same as the monster’s original Attribute.
